text: I've used it for a couple of weeks now and .... I've used it for a couple of weeks now and it works ok, the suction is decent. I always squish my fingers trying to the the red nozzle out of the holder, my husband had the same issue, so it is really hard to get it out. There was also no wall holder included, so the vac and charger are flying around the house all the time. I also think the battery could use a bit more oomph, you have to recharge quite regularly without getting much work done overall.
